findings.title: Exact condition drain arithmetic
findings.summary: 11 tactic dimensions are summed from Low/Medium/High option intensities using defaults 0/5/7 plus base 15, normalized by 100; classification thresholds are strict >0.40 and >0.65.

findings.title: All 11 tactic semantic tooltips recovered
findings.summary: Build localisation explicitly describes passing, shooting, focus, crossing, possession transitions, mentality, marking, pressing, back line and tackling behaviour.

findings.title: Private best-tactic effectiveness formula
findings.summary: No authoritative client-side numerical score selecting the best tactic for a given XI has been recovered.

findings.title: Mentor effect state reaches live matches
findings.summary: Mentor snapshots are carried in JoinMatchResponse and MatchPeriod; in-match assign/unassign returns full updated mentor state.

findings.title: Seven mentor raw effect arrays captured
findings.summary: Current and next effect arrays are preserved for saboteur, wing_commander, analyst, architect, deadball_specialist, iron_guard and enforcer.

findings.title: Mentor boost units and meanings decoded
findings.summary: Localisation proves tactic boosts are percentage effectiveness values, attribute boosts are +attribute points to all players, and signature array positions have named gameplay semantics.

findings.title: Exact Football Engine consumer
findings.summary: The state/domain flow is proven, but the exact Football Engine numerical fields that consume Mentor CurrentEffects remain unresolved.

findings.title: Explicit stored set-piece duties
findings.summary: Captain, left/right corners, left/right free kicks, penalty kicker and ordered penalty takers are explicit current-client assignments.

findings.title: Automatic captain ranking
findings.summary: No authoritative automatic captain-selection formula has been recovered. Companion keeps captain manual.

findings.title: Current 12-role model and pitch rectangles
findings.summary: Current playable roles are GK, DL, DC, DR, DMC, ML, MC, MR, AML, AMC, AMR, ST with recovered 0–1000 pitch rectangles; DML/DMR are legacy/internal.

findings.title: Role key/white attributes
findings.summary: The client has role->key-attribute data; multi-role players use the union of natural-role key attributes.

findings.title: Current playstyle schema and eligibility source
findings.summary: Current playstyle IDs/levels are known; role eligibility is server-provided PlaystyleDefinition data. Ball Playing GK is not currently offered.

findings.title: Current special ability enum is 1..19
findings.summary: Older build-30527 interpretation treated raw Long Shots as distinct and concluded Shadow Striker absent. Current Windows/WSA client proves raw LongShots is localized/displayed as Shadow striker. See v0.5.9 current-client evidence.

findings.title: Training eligibility is player-specific
findings.summary: Client requests GetAvailableTrainingAbilitiesResponse for a specific player; no universal role->ability training matrix should be invented.

findings.title: Deterministic local skill-point distributor exists
findings.summary: Recovered 3-way group split, deterministic 48-bit LCG, state-dependent per-attribute selection, caps and ceil conversion.

findings.title: Normal ExecuteTraining final AttributeGain is server-returned
findings.summary: Current normal training response carries per-player final AttributeGain arrays; local distributor existence must not be overstated as the normal-session authority.

findings.title: Exact Windows binary identity
findings.summary: TopEleven_Full(4).zip package v27.3.0.0 has GameAssembly/global-metadata hashes identical to the previously inspected build-30527 Windows binaries.

findings.title: Analyst display name is Jonas Braun
findings.summary: Exact build localisation uses mentorName_jonasBraun / Jonas Braun. The companion previously displayed Jonas Brown; v0.5.2 corrects only the display name and leaves the internal analyst ID/effects unchanged.

findings.title: Current level override does not change effect state
findings.summary: mentor-engine effectiveMentor() changes only mentor.level; rawEffects() continues returning the captured arrays and attributeCoverage() counts the Attribute family regardless of level/availability. This can score effects that are not proven active at the overridden level.

findings.title: Mentor boost-family unlock levels
findings.summary: Native client logic separates family availability by Mentor level: Tactical at 1, Attribute at 5, Signature at 10.

findings.title: Complete per-level Mentor magnitudes are not in static boost map
findings.summary: MentorBoostMap carries presentation/localisation metadata while CurrentEffects/NextLevelEffects arrive in Mentor state. No complete local Level 1-10 numeric ladder has been recovered.
unresolved: Level 1-10 numeric magnitudes for every Mentor/effect

findings.title: Mentor match application appears server-side
findings.summary: Inspected live-match state update and assign/unassign paths transport Mentor snapshots without visible local football arithmetic; no obvious Mentor-named Football Engine consumer was found in the broad metadata pass.

findings.title: Lineup Balance affects ball-winning chance and possession
findings.summary: Current shipped guidance states that better Lineup Balance improves the chance of winning the ball and therefore possession; exact 0-10 calculation remains private.

findings.title: Current hard and irregular formation rules decompiled
findings.summary: SquadUtil current native validator plus shipped localisation establish exact goalkeeper/defender/midfield/central/flank/attacking-area requirements and per-role crowding caps; irregular warnings separately require ST-or-AMC, both flanks, DC, DMC-or-MC and MC-or-AMC presence.

findings.title: Lower-OVR natural ST produced higher Lineup Balance
findings.summary: In a controlled same-slot ST substitution, quality-44 François Roelandt raised server Lineup Balance from ~9.8298 to 10.0 versus quality-51 Gosling Lataille. Both were natural STs. Roelandt also had a slightly lower equal-weight mean across all nine ST key attributes, ruling out both OVR-only and equal-all-white-average explanations for this observation. This remains a valid historical observation for that state, but v0.5.5 current re-testing shows it must not be interpreted as proof of ST skill weighting.
unresolved: Which player/profile inputs caused the Balance increase

findings.title: White/key attributes may have unequal role importance
findings.summary: Unequal role-specific white-skill importance remains plausible for match actions, but the historical ST Lineup Balance comparison is no longer accepted as direct evidence for it. Current re-testing shows a much stronger Lataille and weaker Roelandt both display 9.9 Balance in the same slot.
unresolved: Whether Lineup Balance uses role-skill weights at all

findings.title: Future training should support evidence-backed skill priority tiers
findings.summary: If unequal role-specific white-skill importance is proven, training should prioritise primary role attributes while keeping secondary/supporting white skills strong instead of forcing every white skill toward one equal target. Numeric examples such as 250/180 are illustrative only and are not approved constants.

findings.title: Current striker swap displays unchanged 9.9 Lineup Balance
findings.summary: In the current user lineup, swapping OVR-157 Stellar Gosling Lataille and OVR-103 Rare François Roelandt in the ST slot leaves the displayed Lineup Balance at 9.9, despite Lataille now being stronger across essentially the entire ST key-skill profile.
unresolved: Whether underlying server Balance floats are exactly equal or merely round to the same 9.9 display

findings.title: Lineup Balance is not a safe proxy for per-role skill weights
findings.summary: The historical Roelandt/Lataille Balance delta should be interpreted as whole-lineup/placement compatibility evidence, not proof that Shooting/Finishing carry greater ST Balance weight. Per-role skill priority must be researched independently.
unresolved: What exact inputs Lineup Balance compares across the XI

findings.title: Tier OVR contribution scales with player-wide key-attribute count
findings.summary: Tier grants a fixed bonus to every player-wide key attribute. For outfield players, underlying Tier OVR contribution is bonus × key-count / 15. UI examples confirm ST Stellar +50 across 9 keys => +30 OVR; AML Rare +10 across 8 keys => ~+5.33 underlying / +5 displayed; AMC+AMR Rare +10 across 9 union keys => +6 OVR.
unresolved: Exact UI rounding implementation beyond tested examples
Whether any match-engine path uses reconstructed pre-Tier attributes rather than permanent post-Tier values

findings.title: Current legal formation space exhaustively enumerated
findings.summary: Recovered build-30527 rules yield 2,843 hard-legal role-count configurations, 1,893 warning-free configurations and 249 warning-free exactly symmetric configurations. A transparent one-slot advisory-robustness companion filter leaves 12 symmetric candidates.

findings.title: 4-1-1-3-1 DMC+MC is current default long-term Target Formation candidate
findings.summary: GK/DL/DC/DC/DR/DMC/MC/AML/AMC/AMR/ST is fully legal, warning-free, symmetric and one-slot advisory-resilient, covers 18/19 active Playstyles and provides complementary DMC+MC key-attribute profiles while preserving both-flank and central tactical options. This is a transparent app target, not an official Nordeus best-formation claim.

findings.title: Target formation should be a tactic-flexible platform, not a fixed tactic preset
findings.summary: The DMC+MC target keeps both flanks and a full central spine occupied, so tactic selection can remain XI/context-driven under exact drain constraints. No single passing/focus/cross/pressing preset is hard-coded from formation alone.

findings.title: Assistant Feedback exposes tactic/context relationships
findings.summary: Build 30527 ships 227 Assistant Feedback strings. Relevant messages explicitly relate short passing to possession/midfield control; defensive situations to long balls+counter-attacks; fast players to counter-attacks; lane focus to where passing succeeds; midfield numbers to possession; high press to ball recovery with fatigue trade-off; attacking style to offside-trap use; and card accumulation to easing tackling. These are semantic/context relationships, not numerical match weights.

findings.title: Assistant Feedback trigger logic is server-owned in MatchPeriod
findings.summary: Nordeus.Communication.MatchPeriod carries HomeMatchFeedback/AwayMatchFeedback, and MatchFeedback contains Minute, StringId and AssistantId. The client receives the selected feedback message rather than exposing the conditions that selected it. Exact trigger thresholds/decision rules are therefore not recovered client-side.
unresolved: server-side assistant feedback trigger thresholds and selection logic

findings.title: Robust frontier has two 18/19-playstyle leaders
findings.summary: Among all 12 symmetric warning-free one-slot-advisory-resilient role-count shapes, two cover 18/19 active Playstyles: the advanced-wide DMC+MC shape (DL DC DC DR / DMC MC / AML AMC AMR / ST), missing only False Winger, and the midfield-wide DMC+MC shape (DL DC DC DR / DMC ML MC MR / AMC ST), missing only Inside Forward. The advanced-wide version remains the default target because it retains four advanced attacking roles and higher Shooting/Finishing role-key membership while preserving every native structural warning group.

findings.title: Signature semantics are not integrated into current Mentor ranking
findings.summary: mentor-synergy-v3 ranks direct Tactical match, active Attribute key-skill coverage, Signature-unlocked Boolean, then stable order. Exact Signature activation conditions/trade-offs are supporting text only, so three-effect Mentor decision support is not finished.

findings.title: Mentors have three Prestige levels after Level 10
findings.summary: Current client and official Help both prove Mentor progression continues after Level 10 through 3 Prestige levels; client state exposes PriceForNextPrestige/PrestigeProgress and resource strings identify Signature Seals as the Prestige gating currency used to upgrade Signature Move.
findings.confidence: high for current official product rules

findings.title: First qualitative ST Playstyle priority bands preserved
findings.summary: Cross-source evidence supports a qualitative ST scoring core of Shooting+Finishing with Positioning structural support; Poacher, Target Man and False Nine receive separate evidence-based modifiers. No private numeric Nordeus weights are claimed.

findings.title: Current community structure evidence does not overturn Formation v1
findings.summary: Recent player reports repeatedly value midfield control and often pair a single DMC with a back four; these observations are compatible with the current target but remain anecdotal and do not prove a universal best formation.

findings.title: Current ST Special Ability weighting cannot be safely recovered from static/community evidence
findings.summary: Current client explicitly represents role/player SA eligibility and exact live-match SA activation events, but no universal static role→SA table or comparable inherent effect multiplier/ranking has yet been recovered. Shadow Striker is current via the LongShots internal alias. Community rankings remain contradictory, so ST SA numeric weighting stays unresolved pending deeper native/static work or controlled event captures.

findings.title: ST tactic context can be separated by Playstyle without fixed presets
findings.summary: Target Man has the strongest current context match: official aerial-pass/hold-up semantics plus Lewis Green's extracted Wing/Crossing/Heading/Aerial package support cross/aerial service. False Nine and Poacher have clear role semantics but insufficient evidence for fixed passing/focus/counter presets.
findings.confidence: medium-high for Target Man; medium/low for fixed settings on the others
unresolved: whether Long Pass is a specific Target Man engine trigger

findings.title: Signature-aware Mentor decision architecture mapped without universal numeric scoring
findings.summary: All seven Signatures are now mapped to explicit pre-match or halftime/live context rules. Herrera/Green have direct selected-plan/action context; Braun and Makélélé depend on live halftime/score state; Cesc, Shearer and Vidić carry explicit opportunity/cost/risk context. Production recommender remains unchanged pending rule tests.

findings.title: LongShots is the current internal alias for Shadow Striker
findings.summary: Current client localizes special_ability_6 and LongShots UI keys as Shadow striker; the production alias was correct and v0.5.8 research wording was not.

findings.title: Three Special Ability slots are supported
findings.summary: Current metadata/resources expose first/second/third ability fields and explicit Third Special Ability reward/UI text.

findings.title: SA and Playstyle activations are explicit match-stream events
findings.summary: Football Engine streaming descriptors record SpecialAbilityType and PlaystyleTriggerType/PlaystyleOutcomeType, enabling future controlled capture counting.

findings.title: Per-Playstyle post-match semantic feedback exists
findings.summary: Current resources contain Playstyle-specific post-match and trait-test text. Target Man explicitly links to high balls, aerial control, long passes, crosses and hold-up; analogous semantics exist for all current Playstyles.

findings.title: Signature Seals are the Prestige gating currency
findings.summary: Current resource strings explicitly state Signature Seals Prestige Mentors and further improve Signature Moves.

findings.title: Current client still models condition drain across all 11 tactic dimensions
findings.summary: TacticsConditionDrainSettings/Overrides/Repo/Service cover all 11 tactical families. Current numeric override values were not safely recovered from the newer client.

findings.title: 2024-26 forum + Reddit rules support joint plan scoring
findings.summary: Recent community evidence repeatedly supports central midfield/DMC coverage, opponent weak-lane exploitation, plan-dependent passing and Mentor alignment, while conflicting on a universal 3CB/back-four winner or one fixed tactic recipe. Use these as transparent companion ranking rules only.
findings.confidence: medium-high for structural principles; lower for individual formation/mentor matchup anecdotes
